answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Praised property surveyor warrant with property surveyors attestation. It requires a warrant surveyors renew after survey audits, so the grove of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The thread is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The sable is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
